caption: The drawing depicts a square of patterned fabric with a grid-like design. The background consists of a small-scale, repeating geometric brown lattice pattern. Overlaid on this are broad, alternating vertical and horizontal stripes in shades of brown and beige, intersected by checkered squares composed of brown, black, pale blue, and off-white squares. Large, detailed, stylized flowers and leaves in various shades of brown, green, and pink are arranged between the grid stripes. Some of the flowers are open and show inner details in brown and pink hues, while others are buds or partially opened, attached to brown and green stems. The composition is symmetrical, with the grid forming a prominent framework for the placement of the floral elements. The fabric sample is centered on a plain, off-white background, and there is handwriting, "Suzanne Roy," in the lower left margin outside the patterned area.
title: Printed Cotton
